decisions.quote: We conducted a conceptual replication of that study to investigate the effectiveness of the AntiBias statement across a Department of Biological Sciences over three semesters. The AntiBias treatment inconsistently affected the SETs, sometimes improving women's scores but often not having any effect.
decisions.reason: Across the title, abstract, discussion, and conclusions, the authors frame their three-semester replication of Peterson et al. (2019) as yielding variable, inconsistent results—aligning with the original finding in Fall 2021 where the AntiBias statement improved women instructors' scores, while finding no effect in Spring 2021 and Spring 2022 and therefore not supporting consistent departmental-scale mitigation—which matches the codebook definition of mixed.
